sutta: 11.12 at savarti in jesus grove there the blessed ones head to the mounts monks in the past when sakha devaraja was a human being he was a brahmana youth named maga therefore he is now called magawa monks in the past and sakha devaraja was a human being he gave gifts in city after city therefore he is called purin dada the urban giver monks in the past when saka devaraja was a human being he gave gifts considerably therefore he is called sakka monks in the past when saka devaraja was a human being he gave a rest house therefore he is called vasava monk sakadevaraja thinks of a thousand matters in a moment therefore he is called sahasaka thousand i you can also take it to mean that he has a psychic ability to see a thousand places in a in a moment monks saka's wife is the asura maiden named suja therefore he is called su jampati suja's exercises supreme sovereignty and rulership over the tawatimsa devas therefore he is called lord of the devas devaraja in the past when saka devaraja was a human being he adopted and undertook seven vows by the undertaking of which he achieved the status of sakha and these seven vows are as i said just now as long as i leave me i support my parents as long as i leave me i respect the family elders as long as i leave me i speak gently as long as i believe may i not speak divisively as long as i leave me i dwell at home with the mind devoid of the stain of stinginess freely generous open handed delighting in relinquishment etc number six as long as i leave me i speak the truth number seven as long as i live may i be free from anger and if anger should arise in me may i dispel it quickly so here we get to know why the sakadevaraja has these various names
